phrases.text: I usually wake up early in the morning.

translations.es: Normalmente me despierto temprano en la mañana.
translations.en: I usually wake up early in the morning.

phrases.text: Sometimes I go for a walk after lunch.

translations.es: A veces salgo a caminar después de almorzar.
translations.en: Sometimes I go for a walk after lunch.

phrases.text: After work, I like to relax at home.

translations.es: Después del trabajo, me gusta relajarme en casa.
translations.en: After work, I like to relax at home.

phrases.text: I always have a cup of coffee first.

translations.es: Siempre tomo una taza de café primero.
translations.en: I always have a cup of coffee first.

phrases.text: Then, I take a shower and get dressed.

translations.es: Luego, me doy una ducha y me visto.
translations.en: Then, I take a shower and get dressed.

phrases.text: I never go to bed late on weekdays.

translations.es: Nunca me acuesto tarde los días de semana.
translations.en: I never go to bed late on weekdays.

phrases.text: We usually have dinner around eight o'clock.

translations.es: Normalmente cenamos alrededor de las ocho en punto.
translations.en: We usually have dinner around eight o'clock.
